positions.title: Software Developer & Open Source contributor
positions.description:
Open Source software contributor to:

- https://civic.band/ - The largest collection of civic meeting data in the United States and Canada
- Fastly - go-fastly, Terraform provider

- https://rv.dev/ - Modern Ruby tooling
- stacksjs/ts-punycode - TypeScript Punycode converter

positions.description:
